content: UIKit views in non-template CarPlay scene: CarTube already proves arbitrary UIKit (WKWebView, custom keyboard, UIHostingController) renders and receives touches in a UIWindowScene with role UIWindowSceneSessionRoleCarPlay — the scene-role manifest mechanism is what routes content to the car screen, not CPTemplate usage. Adding UITableView/UIButton overlays to the same UIWindow follows the identical mechanism the existing keyboard uses. Trade-off: no template = no driver-distraction policing from CarPlay framework; app must self-limit interaction while driving (CarTube already accepts this posture for the webview itself).
